chartExamples.describe: Scatter plot "Ad spend vs. signups". 12 points of signups against spend, in 3 groups (Search, Social, Video). Correlation 0.71 (strong positive). signups ranges from 150 to 720.

Donut chart "Traffic by source". 5 slices totalling 97.8K. Largest: Organic (49.3%). The top 3 (Organic, Direct, Referral) make up 84.3%.
Histogram "API response time". 200 values of ms in 13 bins of width 10. Mean 126.9, median 122, range 80 to 201. Most common bin: 120 to 130 (34 values).

Box plot "Delivery time by carrier". Distribution of days for 3 groups (Aero, Bolt, Cargo). Aero: median 4.15, middle half 3.3 to 4.48, range 2 to 9.4, 1 outlier. Bolt: median 4.1, middle half 3.32 to 5.23, range 2.9 to 14, 1 outlier. Cargo: median 5.55, middle half 4.53 to 7.2, range 3.6 to 14.6, 1 outlier.

chartExamples.describe: Gauge "Cluster utilisation". 3 values on arcs from 0% to 100%; a filled arc's length is the value's share of that range. Two value axes with independent scales: the left axis shows v (4 to 8); the right axis (Rate) shows r (1.5 to 2.3). Where a line meets the bars or how steep they look depends on the two chosen ranges, not on the data.

describeCases.name: bar: a broken axis
describeCases.describe: Bar chart. 3 categories. Highest: c (950). Lowest: a (3). Total: 961. The value axis is broken: the span from 10 to 900 is cut out, so bars that cross it are drawn shorter than their value; the values given here are the real ones.

describeCases.name: bar: a broken axis with a value inside the cut
describeCases.describe: Bar chart. 3 categories. Highest: c (950). Lowest: a (3). Total: 1,033. The value axis is broken: the span from 10 to 900 is cut out, so bars that cross it are drawn shorter than their value; the values given here are the real ones. 1 value lies inside the cut and is drawn at its edge.

describeCases.name: line: a broken axis

describeCases.name: area: stream graph (stack center)
describeCases.describe: Stream graph. 2 series (a, b) over a numeric x axis. a: from 1 at 1 to 3 at 2 (200.0%); peak 3 at 2, low 1 at 1. b: from 2 at 1 to 1 at 2 (-50.0%); peak 2 at 1, low 1 at 2. The layers are stacked around a centre line, so the vertical axis has no zero; the thickness of each layer is its value.

describeCases.name: timeline: numbers, a reversed and a missing range, overlap
describeCases.describe: Timeline. 3 ranges in 2 lanes (A, B), from 0.0 to 9.0. First: A at 0.0. Last to end: B at 9.0. Longest: B (7.0). Ranges overlap in 1 lane.

describeCases.name: timeline: times of day, series and labels
describeCases.describe: Timeline "Shifts". 2 ranges in 2 lanes (Ana, Ben), coloured by g (P, Q), from Mar 7, 2026, 22:00 to Mar 9, 2026, 08:30. First: Night at Mar 7, 2026, 22:00. Last to end: Day at Mar 9, 2026, 08:30. Longest: Day (1 d 3 h).
